test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements : **

1. All flowers are tulips.

2. No tulips are whites.

**Conclusions :**

I. All tulips are flowers.

II. Some tulips are whites.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc07d06d28cfa0b1126d4d59d70f6da9ebdf44f38232550cef8a4f747026fb54.png] 

Conclusions :

I. All tulips are flowers → False (As All flowers are tulips so, All tulips are flowers, hence, False)

II. Some tulips are whites → False (As No tulips are whites so, Some tulips are whites, hence, False)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows".**
